slack.message:
*Harbor & Pine Health*
A nurse practitioner requests prior authorization for an MRI, and the payer team sees the case in Slack when it stalls.
1. Harbor & Pine Health is the clinic account, with Avery Cole as the patient.
2. A case is filed for prior authorization of an MRI, waiting on the clinical note.
3. The case stalls past the payer's two-day window.
4. The case moves to closed once the note arrives and the request is approved.
Tag: [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]

manualSteps.title: Install the Slack app from the manifest
manualSteps.detail: In Slack, create an app from slack/manifest.json and install it on your org. On Enterprise Grid, install it on the org, not on one workspace, and approve it if an admin must. On a single workspace, remove oauth_config.scopes.user before installing. Skip this when the app is already installed.

manualSteps.title: Store the bot token where Salesforce can use it
manualSteps.detail: Copy the bot token from the install into a Salesforce named credential for https://slack.com/api. Keep the token out of git and out of the demo spec. On Enterprise Grid, also keep the org-admin user token in the agent secret store. Skip this when the credential already exists.

manualSteps.title: Connect a Salesforce demo org
manualSteps.detail: Sign the coding agent into a demo, sandbox, or developer org where it can create accounts and cases. If that org requires a hosted MCP server, create the external client app in Setup and finish the login.

manualSteps.title: Mark the demo org, the production orgs, and the Slack org
manualSteps.detail: Copy demos/org.example.json to demos/org.local.json. Set demoOrgLabel to the demo org's company name. List every production org under productionOrgLabels. Set slack.orgName and slack.enterpriseGrid. Skip this when the file is already filled in.

manualSteps.title: Check the trial date
manualSteps.detail: If the demo org is a trial, put trialExpires in demos/org.local.json as YYYY-MM-DD. Renew or replace the org when that date is near. Skip this when the org does not expire.

manualSteps.title: Deploy the Salesforce flow that posts to Slack
manualSteps.detail: The flow is an after-save flow on Case. It posts salesforce/slack-post.json when a tagged case is created or its status changes. Deploy it with the Salesforce CLI or Metadata API. Skip this when that flow is already active in the demo org.

agentSteps.title: Confirm the demo org
agentSteps.detail: Read demos/org.local.json. The connected Salesforce org must match demoOrgLabel. If its name is in productionOrgLabels, or its host is in productionOrgHosts, stop before any write.

agentSteps.title: Channel: #healthcare-prior-auth
agentSteps.detail: Create #healthcare-prior-auth with conversations.create in the workspace where Demo Publisher is installed. Invite the bot. Use that channel for every post.

agentSteps.title: Beat 1: Account
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Account. Harbor & Pine Health is the clinic account, with Avery Cole as the patient. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 2: Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Case. A case is filed for prior authorization of an MRI, waiting on the clinical note. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 3: Account + Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Account and Case. The case stalls past the payer's two-day window. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 4: Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Case. The case moves to closed once the note arrives and the request is approved. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Wire Salesforce changes to Slack
agentSteps.detail: Activate an after-save flow on Case for records whose Subject contains [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. On create and on Status change, POST the body in salesforce/slack-post.json to the channel from this plan. The named credential holds the bot token.

agentSteps.title: Save the spec
agentSteps.detail: Write this plan to demos/healthcare-prior-auth.json with salesforceIds left empty. Put record ids and the Slack channel id only in demos/healthcare-prior-auth.links.json.
